facts.fact: The Government of Mauritius launched a public consultation on 10 April 2025 on a draft report on child online safety, posted on the ministry website, with views taken by email or the MAIA+ chatbot from 15 April 2025.

facts.fact: Mauritius's Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation launched a public consultation on 10 April 2025 on a draft child online safety report, inviting parents, educators, youths, NGOs and civil society to send views.
